references.name: whole-roof-2007
references.author: Peellden
references.observed: 2007 ordinary elevated whole-roof view inspected. Rectangular main headhouse,large continuous four-sided red/orange tiled sloping roof with slightly concave transitions,white/light-grey outer coping and high rectangular inner collar. A terrace/service ring lies within the collar;central main-hall roof has six long parallel pale glazed gables,with boxy equipment and two visible lattice communication frames. Tall repeated square entrance piers and beige grid/frieze bands continue along both visible facades. Separate forecourt canopies,subway entrance structures,elevated road and neighboring construction are not the terminal body. No copied signs,emblems,vehicles,people or neighboring construction.

references.name: south-front-2026
references.author: Bigmorr
references.observed: September2026 ordinary southern-front view inspected. The red hipped roof/high pale collar remains;outer pale coping has strong projecting eaves with soffit panels. Beige/grey tiled or plaster-faced facade has tall lower columns/recessed glass,deep upper rectangular lattice grids and horizontal perforated/frieze bands. Current nearby metro entrance shelters and bus canopies remain separate from the main terminal. No copied lettering,emblems,flags,vehicles,people or signs. The frontage photo does not verify current rooftop equipment inventory.
